## Failure paths and arms (fill in)

- **Scope and candidate.** PR #247 closes the active transport-recording consumer missed when the store default moved from 8443 to 18443. The current candidate is `c2cafb972bb891cd2eceb89345c3c6a23a5b37bb` (tree `9bc97938a6de641b06596267da97fd2412fd0c0f`). The exact candidate archive rebuilt the controller, Gateway and store binaries. The committed five-node transport topology was copied with name-only `tx-` → `p247-` substitutions; the wrapper, specs and production sources were used unchanged, without a store-port override. The rendered inventory has the declared FreeIPA server/client, Gateway, target-policy, store and workstation groups. Alignment decision **A**: provision the declared groups. Inputs contain the administrator password, store master/signing keys and fixture-user password; values remain outside Git.
- **Current formal chain.** The machine section above is the exact-candidate **steady-state** L1 syntax → L3 check/diff → L4 apply → L5 Gateway 33/33, target-policy 5/5, store 27/27 (all zero skips) → L6 `changed=0` on all five nodes. L6 recaps: Gateway `ok=285`, IPA `90`, store `234`, target `214`, workstation `5`; all `failed=0`. No skip-lint/checkmode flags were used. This is not presented as a fresh final-candidate installation.
- **Wrong-URL counterexample and recovery.** From the recording-free owned baseline, read-only SQLite query confirmed the probe session absent. Configure only the Gateway URL to `https://p247-store.ipa.pilot.internal:8443` through the real Gateway apply with single-VM `target_group=all`; read back the installed URL. The committed `--phase recording` script returned **1**, with two expected policy-denial probes passing and the recording probe failing: `/v1/sessions/start` to port 8443 received connection refused, `recording_started=0`, `NO-SESSION`, and no target shell marker. A second read-only query confirmed no session row. Restore only the URL to 18443 and read it back: the same committed recording phase returned **0**, **3 pass / 0 fail / 0 skip**. Result: `recorded pilot-connect reached the target shell; recording_started events=1; store: SESSION user=transportuser mode=terminal_output events=7 complete=1`. Portal key/password, store host/key and `expect` were all supplied. A final Gateway apply returned 0 and native transcript showed `changed=0`, `failed=0`; the real store health helper then confirmed active MainPID ownership of 18443 and trusted configured TLS identity (HTTP 405).
- **Fresh startup and failure accounting.** Before the documentation edit, a clean `d7c81e17` archive provisioned these five never-applied VMs, passed fresh L3 and applied every node with `failed=0`; the 18443 recording phase actually passed 3/3. Its initial Gateway verify had 15 per-host invocation timeouts (including `true` rows), and auto-rollback reported an IPA snapshot-revert error. Both failure outputs remain in controlled local artifacts. The same committed Gateway checks, unchanged 45-second timeout, then passed 33/33 alone. A recording-free five-node baseline snapshot and subsequent explicit cluster restore both succeeded. The first fault-control harness selected no Gateway group and caught its unexpected positive result; the corrected control above verifies task selection and installed URL. One over-specific harness assertion also rejected a truncated diagnostic; the accepted control checks the preserved endpoint and connection-refused cause. None of these superseded attempts is counted as a negative proof or successful fresh L1–L6 run.
- **Regression and original producer coverage.** `TestSessionStoreRecordingConsumerDefaults` reads the contract default, both topology store identities and unpinned imports, and checks both active consumer URLs. Both subtests pass; in a separate bounded scratch copy, changing only the active transport URL back to 8443 makes that subtest fail on the port mismatch while the per-host subtest passes. Historical 8443 snapshots and explicit-port fixtures are preserved. Original Wazuh coexistence, custom-port, listener-owner and trusted wrong-hostname arms remain attributed to candidate `4c8be4f`, in the [prior producer evidence](https://github.com/kjelly/pilot/blob/d7c81e17f56978d276d4c44a4a1273a77163be4c/docs/evidence/session-store-ingest/issue-77.md); they are supporting history with unchanged production files, not relabelled as current-candidate target runs.
- **Artifacts and inputs.** Controlled raw logs, native apply transcripts, row NDJSON, baseline snapshots/restores, resource facts, failure output and probe summaries were captured under `.pr-ready/247` and the isolated archive's `.verification` staging directory. The five owned VM directories are absent after sanctioned topology teardown; unrelated VMs were untouched.
